title: Uber only fulfilled 4 rides from AI agents last quarter
summary: AI agents won't be stealing Uber's lunch any time soon. Only four rides were arranged by third-party AI agents during the third quarter of 2026, Uber executives disclosed during an earnings call this morning. The volume of Uber Eats orders fulfilled by AI agents was a little high
reason: Reports AI market/adoption data disclosed on Uber's earnings call (rides and Eats orders fulfilled by third-party AI agents), covered by a reputable media outlet, The Verge. This is market data, not a model release, research artifact, policy action, or OSS tool.
